mapper.sql: SELECT d.*, m.shop_name, c.name AS category_name FROM t_dish d LEFT JOIN t_merchant m ON d.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN t_category c ON d.category_id = c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_dish (merchant_id, category_id, name, description, price, image, status, sales) VALUES (#{merchantId}, #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{image}, #{status}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE t_dish SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_dish SET sales = sales + #{num} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_dish WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId}
